user.title: ebusd
user.description: Address of the ebusd that is connected to the heating system. ebusd must have loaded a release of the Weishaupt definitions. Nothing is written to the heating system unless writes are enabled later in the options.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of ebusd.
data_description.port: TCP command port of ebusd, 8888 unless it was changed.

reconfigure.title: ebusd
reconfigure.description: New address of the same ebusd.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of ebusd.
data_description.port: TCP command port of ebusd, 8888 unless it was changed.

error.cannot_connect: No ebusd answers at this address.

init.title: Bus load and writes

data.writes_enabled: Enable writes of the proven settings

data_description.request_gap: The integration never sends two requests closer together than this.
data_description.cyclic_interval: How often temperatures and other live values are read. Settings, counters and programs are read far less often.
data_description.writes_enabled: Creates a number entity for each setting a release of the definitions proves writable, and the write switch (off). Needs an ebusd build that computes the run-time checksum (john30/ebusd#1825); the integration checks it without sending anything to the bus. Regulation settings are written only after a confirmation in Settings > Repairs.
data_description.telegram_db: Path of the SQLite telegram log the ebusd add-on keeps. A write from the address of the vendor service tool (ff) is refused while the tool may be connected, and when this log cannot be read or is not fed.
data_description.max_writes_per_hour: Writes accepted within any sliding hour (1 to 200, default 30). The limit protects the memory of the regulators from wear: keep 30 in normal service. A higher value is only for a supervised test campaign; set it back to 30 when the campaign ends. Changing it reloads the integration, which restarts the count.

init.description: Load on the bus, and writes. Writes are off unless enabled here; then a write switch on the ebusd device turns them on and off, and only the settings the definitions prove writable can be set.

definitions_mismatch.title: The definitions loaded by ebusd are not those this integration expects
definitions_mismatch.description:
{count} messages of the Weishaupt definitions {version} are missing in ebusd ({missing}) or defined differently ({different}): {messages}.

These values are not shown. Load a release of the definitions in the range {accepted} in ebusd (with `--scanconfig`), then reload the integration.

no_devices.title: No Weishaupt device found on the bus
no_devices.description:
ebusd answers, but none of the addresses the Weishaupt definitions describe is on its bus. Other addresses seen: {addresses}.

Check that ebusd has a signal and has scanned the bus, then reload the integration.

confirm.title: {setting} — {device}

abort.expired: This request has expired or was withdrawn: nothing was written. Set the value again to create a new one.
abort.written: Done. {setting} of {device}: {requested} written and read back from the controller ({read_back}). Telegram `{telegram}`.
abort.unchanged: {setting} of {device} already holds {requested}: nothing was written.
abort.not_taken: {setting} of {device}: {requested} was sent and acknowledged, but the controller reads back {read_back}. The value was not taken over.
abort.write_failed: {setting} of {device}: the write was not sent ({reason}).
abort.no_read_back: {setting} of {device}: {requested} was sent, but could not be read back ({reason}). Check the value before trying again.

writes_disabled.message: Writes are disabled: enable them in the options of the integration and turn the write switch on.

capability_absent.message: This ebusd does not compute the run-time checksum (john30/ebusd#1825): writes refused.

capability_unknown.message: Whether ebusd computes the run-time checksum is not known ({reason}): writes refused.

source_not_own.message: {setting} is proven written from address 31 only, and the address of this ebusd is {own}.

off_step.message: {value} is not on a step of {step} from {minimum}.

out_of_bounds.message: {value} is outside the allowed range {minimum} to {maximum}.

linked_unknown.message: {other} could not be read: write refused.

hourly_limit.message: More than {limit} writes within the hour: write refused.

register_interval.message: This setting was written less than {seconds} s ago.

log_unreadable.message: The telegram log cannot be read ({reason}): write from ff refused.

log_stale.message: The telegram log is not being fed: write from ff refused.

service_tool_active.message: The vendor service tool seems to be connected (recent telegram from ff): write refused.

read_failed.message: {setting} could not be read before the write ({reason}): write refused.

unavailable.message: ebusd cannot be reached: write refused.

no_read_back.message: {setting} was written but could not be read back ({reason}).

not_taken.message: {setting}: {requested} was sent, the controller reads back {read_back}. The value was not taken over.
